evidence.excerpt: The paper's central claims of state-of-the-art performance are inconsistent with the quantitative results. The abstract, Sec. 5.2, and conclusion claim the method 'significantly outperforms previous approaches' and shows 'consistently strong performance across all metrics.' However, Table 1 shows HIVE-3D's IoU ( $0.7449$ ) is substantially worse than the TRELLIS baseline ( $0.8603$ ). Furthermore, image-based metrics in Appendix Table 6 are mixed, with HIVE-3D performing on par with or worse than TRELLIS/MIDI on SSIM and LPIPS. This discrepancy undermines the credibility of the claimed SOTA status.
